content_sections.heading: About NBRC
content_sections.text: The National Brain Research Centre is a Deemed University in Manesar, Gurugram, Haryana. Its letterhead describes it as part of BRIC, a DBT organisation. This post is in Dr. Dhananjay Huilgol's lab at BRIC-NBRC.

content_sections.heading: NBRC Project Associate I Vacancy Details 2026
content_sections.text: The position is under the DBT-funded project "Role of Pax6(+) cortical progenitors in the etiology of Autism Spectrum Disorder". The Project Investigator is Dr. Dhananjay Huilgol, BRIC-NBRC. Apart from HRA, no other allowances are paid. FREEJOBALERT DAILY QUIZ Preparing for Govt Exams? content_sections.heading: NBRC Project Associate I Eligibility 2026
content_sections.text: You can be at most 40 years old. Age is counted on the last date for receiving applications, which is 20 November 2026. You must hold a Masters' degree in Science (MSc) specialising in life sciences, biology or biotechnology, with research interests in Development, Neuroscience and Animal research. Preference goes to candidates with lab experience in basic molecular biology techniques, cell culture or biochemistry. This experience is preferred, not required. Check the official notification for the full eligibility details for this post.

content_sections.heading: Application Fee
content_sections.text: The fee is Rs. 200. You can pay it in either of these ways: A Demand Draft in favour of 'Director, NBRC, Manesar', or An online or UPI payment to the 'National Brain Research Centre' account: Account No. 915010023259375, IFSC Code UTIB0000720, Branch: IMT Manesar.

rows.event: Last date for hard copies to reach NBRC

content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: A duly constituted Screening Committee shortlists the applications, and its decision is final. Only shortlisted candidates are called for an interview. Meeting the minimum qualification and experience does not give you a right to an interview. NBRC does not pay TA/DA for attending the interview and will not reply to interim enquiries.

content_sections.heading: Service Conditions
content_sections.text: The appointment is for one year. It can be renewed for two more years if your performance review is successful. The post is co-terminus with the project. The contract follows the terms of the project and NBRC's rules and procedures in force at the time. NBRC may provide accommodation under its rules, subject to availability.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for NBRC Project Associate I Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Download the application form attached to the official notification. It is the second and third pages of the PDF. Fill in the form. Items 1 to 4 (project title, PI name, position applied for and your name) must be in capital letters. Paste a recent signed passport-size photograph on the form and sign the declaration. Pay the Rs. 200 fee by Demand Draft or online/UPI. Put the form and the documents listed below in an envelope marked "Application for Project Associate-I (Project)". Post it to "The Administrative Officer (Academics), National Brain Research Centre, NH-8, Manesar-122052, Distt Gurugram, Haryana". The first page of the notice gives the address as "The Administrative Officer (Academics), National Brain Research Centre, Nainwal Mode, Gurugram-122052 (Haryana)". Make sure the hard copy reaches NBRC by 20 November 2026. Your filled application form in the prescribed format A detailed CV Self-attested copies of certificates showing your educational qualifications Self-attested copies of your experience certificates A category certificate if you are SC, ST or physically challenged The Rs. 200 Demand Draft, if you pay by DD If your application is incomplete or does not include the self-attested certificates, it will be rejected without any notice to you. NBRC can cancel your candidature at any time if any information you give is found to be incorrect or misleading.

faq.question: Q1. Which project is the NBRC Project Associate-I post for?
faq.answer: It is for the DBT-funded project "Role of Pax6(+) cortical progenitors in the etiology of Autism Spectrum Disorder". Dr. Dhananjay Huilgol is the Project Investigator.

faq.question: Q2. Can I apply by email or online?
faq.answer: No. You must send a hard copy of the filled form with your documents by post to the Administrative Officer (Academics), NBRC, Manesar.

faq.question: Q3. What should I write on the envelope?
faq.answer: Mark the envelope "Application for Project Associate-I (Project)".

faq.question: Q4. How can I pay the Rs. 200 fee?
faq.answer: You can pay by Demand Draft in favour of 'Director, NBRC, Manesar'. You can also pay online or by UPI to account no. 915010023259375 (IFSC UTIB0000720, IMT Manesar branch).

faq.question: Q5. Which date is used to work out my age?
faq.answer: Your age is worked out on the last date for receiving applications, 20 November 2026. On that date you must not be older than 40.

faq.question: Q6. What lab experience gives an advantage?
faq.answer: Experience with basic molecular biology techniques, cell culture or biochemistry is preferred.

faq.question: Q7. How long is the appointment?
faq.answer: It starts at one year and can be extended by up to two more years after a successful performance review. It ends when the project ends.

faq.question: Q8. Will NBRC pay my travel to the interview?
faq.answer: No. NBRC does not pay TA/DA for attending the interview, and it calls only shortlisted candidates.

faq.question: Q9. Is accommodation available?
faq.answer: NBRC may provide accommodation under its rules if any is available.
